goal: Make 'bakeoff bundle' render its 'Write this derived report if needed' command using the same shell-quoting and --out formatting behavior as the ledger command helpers, so custom --out paths and unusual run ids are quoted correctly while the default 'runs' output shape is preserved.
background:
Acceptance criteria:
- When --out is the default ('runs' or empty), bundle renders the derived-report command in its existing default shape (byte-identical to today for vanilla run ids).
- When --out is a custom path containing characters that need quoting (spaces, shell metacharacters), the rendered command quotes the --out value using the same helper(s) the ledger command helpers in internal/ledger use.
- When the run id contains characters that need quoting, the rendered command quotes the run id consistently with the ledger helpers.
- Existing bundle output for vanilla run ids and the default --out remains byte-identical except where quoting is added for previously unsafe inputs.
- Focused tests in internal/commands/bundlecmd cover default --out, custom --out path requiring quoting, and unusual run id quoting; 'go test ./internal/commands/bundlecmd ./internal/ledger' passes.

Edit boundary:
- internal/commands/bundlecmd/bundle.go
- internal/commands/bundlecmd/bundle_test.go
- internal/ledger/*.go (helper exposure only if needed)
Bakeoff will capture candidate patches from isolated worktrees and will not apply them to this checkout.

build.comparison_goal: Prefer the patch that satisfies the acceptance criteria with the smallest maintainable change.
